intro: A holder selects and highlights certain elements; he compares his statement with the full text to detect exaggeration, omission or emotional language.

bloques.titulo: A holder selects and highlights certain elements; he compares his statement with the full text to detect exaggeration, omission or emotional language.
texto: A holder selects and highlights certain elements; he compares his statement with the full text to detect exaggeration, omission or emotional language.
A question, a quote or a strong verb may present an interpretation as if it were a confirmed fact.

frases.ru: Заголовок обещает «полное решение проблемы», но текст сообщает только о запуске пилотного проекта.
frases.es: El titular promete «resolver por completo el problema», pero el texto solo anuncia un proyecto piloto.
frases.en: The headline promises «completely solve the problem», but the text only announces a pilot project.

frases.ru: В статье уточняется, что программа охватывает три района и будет оценена через год.
frases.es: El artículo aclara que el programa cubre tres distritos y se evaluará dentro de un año.
frases.en: The article clarifies that the programme covers three districts and will be evaluated within one year.

bloques.pregunta: What limits the scope of the news?

opciones.explicacion: The body of the text describes a limited pilot and a subsequent evaluation.

opciones.texto: The problem is already completely solved.
opciones.explicacion: This form does not express the relationship that the question calls for.

opciones.texto: The programme covers the entire region
opciones.explicacion: Check which word rules the case or the structure.

bloques.frase: Заголовок обещает «полное решение проблемы», но текст сообщает только о запуске пилотного проекта.

opciones.texto: The headline promises «completely solve the problem», but the text only announces a pilot project.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: The article clarifies that the programme covers three districts and will be evaluated within one year.
opciones.explicacion: That's the translation of the second example.

bloques.frase: В статье уточняется, что программа охватывает три района и будет оценена через год
bloques.traduccion: The article clarifies that the programme covers three districts and will be evaluated within one year.
bloques.explicacion: Look at the order of words and the outstanding grammatical form.
